scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @cabinsentinel/api-client --workspace @cabinsentinel/domain --workspace @cabinsentinel/mobile --workspace @cabinsentinel/owner-web && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: oxlint apps packages && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.validate:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
